description:
## Problem
18 TPC-DI sidecars carry this token for old-generator reasons: 12 from #4307 and 6 from #4222 ('Generated before the TPC-DI scale correction'); 3 more from #3645 have no custom reason and are out of scope. #4307 flagged 12 TPC-DI bundles produced by an older generator with `defective-variant-or-loader-wrong-result`, whose canonical text says the run produced wrong values. They are only from an older generator; a custom `known_defect_reason` overrides the displayed text.

## Change
Relabel the 18 sidecars (12 from #4307, 6 from #4222) with the owner-approved id `superseded-data-generator` and text "Produced by a superseded data generator; not comparable with current bundles." The 3 from #3645 are out of scope.

## Decision gates
The id and text are approved (see context). Before committing, check how the Explorer renders a label id it does not know; if it breaks or hides the bundles' status, stop and report.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the 18 sidecars carry the approved label; bundle bytes and hashes are unchanged; corpus validation and the inventory check pass; ranking exclusion of the 18 is unchanged; after deployment the Explorer shows the new text.

## Additions from the item review
- #4340 adds another label in the same `KNOWN_DEFECT_TOKENS` hunk of benchbox/validation/bundle.py; whichever merges second merges develop first.


## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
Accepted by the owner in the choice dialog: the agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. It arms with `make pr-arm` once per pull request and reports the result. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed. A blocked step stops this item; the agent moves to the next item and does not work around the block.
Review threads: the accepted text also said the agent never resolves a thread. Asked afterwards which rule applies, the owner chose: "The morning rule: I may resolve a thread once the bot has reviewed the new head and did not raise the finding again." ('I' is the agent.) So the agent pushes the fix and replies, and resolves a thread only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise that finding again.
